purpose: Starting points for ROOT (RDataFrame, RooFit, C++/PyROOT) and uproot/awkward analysis code
environment: E1 (docs/capability-matrix.md) plus uproot 5.7.6, awkward 2.14.0, PyYAML 6.0.3 in .venv-hep; ROOT 6.40.04 (conda-forge, Python 3.11.16, conda gcc 16.2.0, C++20 build) in a project-local micromamba environment, cmake 3.28.3; tests find it through HEP_ROOT_PYTHON or HEP_ROOT_CONFIG
status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses; each tool's own status is in tools[]
